name: 颜色通道相关性
description: 检查 how RGB 颜色通道 correlate with each other. Natural light produces predictable inter-channel 相关性s that AI generators fail to reproduce accurately.
mechanism: 分析 统计 相关性s 之间 R, G, B channels. Real photographs exhibit natural inter-channel 相关性s from scene 光照. AI images produce subtly different 模式.
parameters: 块大小: 32x32, Metrics: Pearson 相关性 R-G/R-B/G-B, global 直方图 相关性
accuracy: 低-中 - 60-70%, best as complementary signal
source: Adapted from Gijsenij et al. (2011), color constancy forensics
useCase: Supplementary 检测 of AI生成的 color 分布 异常

references.title: Gijsenij, A. et al. (2011). Computational Color Constancy: Survey and Experiments. IEEE TIP.
Riess, C. & Angelopoulou, E. (2010). Scene Illumination as an Indicator of Image Manipulation. Information Hiding.

strengths:
• Fast and computationally lightweight
• Captures natural 光照 properties
• Works 跨 different image formats
• Good complementary signal with other methods
limitations:
• Lower standalone 准确度 (60-70%)
• Color-corrected images may produce false results
• Monochrome or limited-palette images are difficult
• AI models improving at reproducing natural color 相关性s
